notes_for_editor: The Forest Lookouts listing is the only source tying this site to Seminole County (no agency, build date or design). Two web searches found no Florida Forest Service record for a Seminole County tower. The 2015 Florida chapter report names several 'Seminole' towers without locations, so identity needs checking before publishing. The 2010 Firehouse/WFTV piece gives a statewide phase-out and a three-county count (Orange, Seminole, Brevard), not a Seminole figure. The OSM point (elevation 16 m) is tagged tower:construction lattice, with an edit note about a communication mast; not checked against imagery or on site. The record's status 'unknown' is kept.
